audit.GOOGLE_DRIVE_FIELD_SOURCE: driveFolderId inside projectProvisioning.service.ts evaluated as data.googleDrive.enabled ? (data.googleDrive.generatedFolderId || ...) : undefined
audit.ROOT_CAUSE: The Firestore JS SDK throws 'Unsupported field value: undefined' when writing an object containing properties explicitly set to 'undefined' (such as settings.googleDriveFolderId and settings.googleSpreadsheetId when Google Drive integration is disabled). Because Firestore is initialized using getFirestore() without ignoreUndefinedProperties: true, this local validation fails and aborts the creation before sending a write request to the server, while the project number generator transaction has already executed and consumed Q-PRJ-001.
audit.REQUIRED_FIX: Two complementary solutions are recommended: 1) Initialize Firestore with the ignoreUndefinedProperties flag by using initializeFirestore(app, { ignoreUndefinedProperties: true }) in src/firebase/config.ts, and 2) Ensure payload creation in projectProvisioning.service.ts recursively strips out undefined fields or maps optional/blank fields to null/omission.
